response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim > 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

assumptions.assumption: The number of matched records is the count of advancedbehavior-to-transactionrecord matched pairs (join rows) per order type mix. Since transreg is the primary key of transactionrecord, each advanced behaviour record matches at most one transaction record, so this equals the number of advanced behaviour records.
Records with a NULL ordertypedist form their own group, which GROUP BY does by default and which is shown as NULL.
